security deposit: Rules on security deposit amounts and refunds can differ by state and by local tenancy law. A local lawyer can tell you what applies.
non-compete: Whether post-employment restrictions can be relied on depends on the law that applies and the facts. Ask an employment lawyer.
stamp duty: Stamp duty and registration requirements for leases differ by state. Check with a local lawyer or the sub-registrar office.
eviction: Eviction procedures are governed by state rent-control and tenancy laws, which differ across India.
